business_problem: STIHL Group needed to scale and consolidate its SAP landscape while improving storage efficiency and keeping mission-critical business applications highly available as data volumes kept growing.
solution_summary: STIHL Group expanded its existing IBM environment with a larger SAP HANA on IBM Power platform and modernized storage on IBM FlashSystem. Working with SVA and IBM, the company deployed IBM Power E1080 enterprise servers running IBM PowerVM and SUSE Linux Enterprise Server for SAP Applications to host a broad SAP portfolio including SAP S/4HANA and SAP BW/4HANA. On the storage side, IBM FlashSystem 7300 with FlashCore Modules and NVMe technology delivered dense, low-latency capacity for fast-growing data volumes. The architecture is designed for always-on manufacturing operations: Power provides the resiliency and scale needed for 24/7 business processing, while FlashSystem reduces footprint and simplifies operations. Together, compute and storage modernization let STIHL run very large SAP HANA databases efficiently while cutting the number of storage systems required and preserving room for further growth.

evidence_quotes: Together, STIHL Group, SVA and IBM implemented a highly scalable SAP HANA® on IBM Power solution based on IBM® Power® E1080 enterprise servers.
With IBM FlashSystem 7300, we’re delivering 6 PB of data storage with 50% fewer storage systems.
